title: Introducing bStocks: Tokenized Securities 1:1 Backing with 24/7 Trading
text: This is a general announcement. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region. bStocks are offered through an Approved Prospectus in the ADGM and are not offered in any other jurisdiction.  bStocks are Tokenized securities issued by BTech Holdings Limited, a Binance group affiliate. bStocks are classified as Certificates representing certain Financial Instruments (paragraph 92, Schedule 1 to FSMR). bStocks represent an interest in underlying securities held by the Issuer and are not direct ownership of the underlying Shares. bStocks do not allow holders to directly own a share or stock in the underlying listed company. Fellow Binancians, Binance users can now trade and convert bStocks, tokenized securities each backed 1:1 by a US share held at a regulated custodian.  bStocks are the first tokenized securities admitted to the  FSRA Official List  - and follows regulatory approval of the Issuer’s prospectuses by the ADGM’s Financial Services Authority. What You Can Do with bStocks: Trade 24/7  on the spot market with no market hour restrictions. Convert instantly  between stocks and bStocks at a 1:1 ratio, with no conversion fees. Fully backed by real shares  held at a regulated custodian, and publicly verifiable . Self-custody your way : Supports withdrawal to any compatible BNB Smart Chain wallet. Use in DeFi : bStocks are BNB Smart Chain tokens integrated with BEP-677 (Scaled UI Amount), a token standard providing native support for real-world assets on BNB Smart Chain. Corporate actions on autopilot:  Dividends and splits are processed automatically through the Multiplier mechanism, no action is required on your part. Start from just $5 : Access fractional US stocks exposure with as low as $5. Real Shares, Verifiable Backing Every bStock is fully backed by a US share held at a regulated custodian, verifiable at any time via the  Proof of Collateral  page. Converting between your equities and bStocks is always 1:1, with zero conversion fees. Faster Dividends That Keep Working When the underlying company pays a dividend, you don't wait for a cash payout or lift a finger. The net dividend value is automatically reinvested through an on-chain adjustment known as the Multiplier. It will be credited ahead of the traditional pay date and applied to every fraction you hold. Dividends are subject to applicable US withholding tax (currently 30%) before reinvestment. The net dividend benefit is built into your token's value automatically and your balance simply grows. Settlement in Seconds, Custody in Your Hands Transactions settle under a second with no T+1, settlement windows, nor the need to wait for the next market session. As bStocks are standard BEP-20 tokens, you are never locked into a brokerage: withdraw to any compatible BNB Smart Chain wallet for self-custody, or put them to work across DeFi protocols on BNB Smart Chain. Start your bStocks portfolio today from just $5.Note: There may be discrepancies between this original content in English and any translated versions. Please refer to the original English version for the most accurate information, in case any discrepancies arise. Thank you for your support!
